sentences.text: The fossil specimen was a juvenile with unusually massive proportions, an unusual coracoid, and an unusual humerus compared to Aphrosaurus.
The species Fresnosaurus drescheri was first described by Welles in 1943.
The genus name Fresnosaurus honors Fresno County, and the species name honors Arthur Drescher.
Fresnosaurus likely ate small bony fish, belemnites, and ammonites.
Fresnosaurus is classified in the family Elasmosauridae.
Fresnosaurus lived during the Late Cretaceous (Maastrichtian stage) in what is now California.
Fresnosaurus lived between 72.2 and 66 million years ago during the Maastrichtian.
